title: Decision model
intro: A decision model answers typed questions (yes/no, pick one, score) in well under a second for a fraction of a cent. The app asks it at specific decision points; each point can stay off, run in shadow (asked in the background and measured next to the current logic, changing nothing) or be switched on.
privacy: What is judged (a shell command, a coordinator message, a flow output, a transcript excerpt) is sent to the provider after obvious secrets are masked.
enabledHint: Master switch. While off nothing is sent anywhere and every decision point behaves as before.
instanceHint: Uses the API key of an existing provider instance; no key is stored here.
instanceMissing: No usable account for this backend. Add an OpenRouter instance under Settings → Providers.
modelHint: Keep a pinned snapshot while measuring: the "latest" alias follows new releases and makes shadow numbers incomparable.
price: ${{input}} per million input tokens · output free
timeoutHint: A timed-out call is retried once. Whenever the model cannot answer, the decision point falls back to its old logic.
sitesHint: Start in shadow, watch the agreement below, switch a point on when you trust it.

modeHint.shadow: Asked in the background and logged next to the current verdict; changes nothing.
modeHint.on: Its answer is used; failures fall back to the previous logic.

stall-judge.label: Coordinator stall judge
stall-judge.description: Did the coordinator's last message claim worker spawns that never happened? Replaces a Haiku call per idle coordinator turn.
stall-judge.threshold: Minimum probability of "stalled" before the coordinator is nudged.

tool-risk.label: Shell command risk check
tool-risk.description: A second look at shell commands that would run without asking (auto mode, or an "always allow" grant such as git *). When on, a risky command becomes an approval prompt; an unattended run is never blocked.
tool-risk.threshold: Minimum probability that the command needs approval before you are asked.

flow-judge.label: Flow judge nodes
flow-judge.description: Branch and loop nodes whose match mode is "judge" let the model pick the arm or decide the loop's exit condition instead of matching text.
flow-judge.threshold: Minimum probability for an arm (otherwise the default arm) or for the exit condition to count as met.

phase-gate.label: Rota judge gates
phase-gate.description: Phase gates of kind "judge" ask whether the phase's exit condition holds, judged against the root session's recent transcript. The gate stays closed when the model cannot answer.
phase-gate.threshold: Minimum probability that the exit condition holds before the gate opens.

stats.title: Last {{days}} days
stats.agreementHint: Share of shadow comparisons in which the model reached the same verdict as the current logic.
stats.readyToSwitch: Agreement is high: ready to switch on.
stats.keepShadow: Agreement is low: keep it in shadow.
